tokens.name: bg-page
tokens.usage: The page ground. Warm gray, never pure white.

tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: Sunken panels: settled rows, the unselected step of a two-step header, the ledger footer, segmented control track.

tokens.name: bg-card
tokens.usage: Cards, list rows, inputs, the stage strip, the ledger column.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings. Also the top bar fill, the clean share of the ledger bar, and a settled stage's underline.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on white: table cells, a decided row's title, quiet button labels.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Captions, notes, kickers, third lines. The lightest gray allowed for text. 5.4:1 on bg-surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card borders, dividers, the stage strip's bottom rule.

tokens.name: line-2
tokens.usage: Input borders, secondary button borders, a stage with nothing to decide, the set-aside share of the ledger bar.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Hairlines inside a card, between rows of a table.

tokens.name: on-dark
tokens.usage: Text on ink: the top bar, the dark download band.

tokens.name: on-dark-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on ink.

tokens.name: blue-700
tokens.usage: Text on blue-100. The current stage's name.

tokens.name: blue-500
tokens.usage: NEEDS YOU. Primary buttons, links, the current stage's underline, open rows in the ledger, the NEEDS YOU tag, the ledger's two-counts kicker. Never decoration.

tokens.name: blue-300
tokens.usage: Border of a needs-you callout and of the record panel.

tokens.name: blue-100
tokens.usage: Fill of a needs-you callout, the current stage, an expanded queue row.

tokens.name: green-700
tokens.usage: Text on green-100.

tokens.name: green-500
tokens.usage: A PERSON DECIDED. Confirmed tags, decided rows, a step added by you, a link confirmed by a reviewer. Never for the tool's own verdict; a row that passed every check is ink, not green.

tokens.name: green-300
tokens.usage: Border of a confirmed tag or callout.

tokens.name: green-100
tokens.usage: Fill of a confirmed tag or callout.

tokens.name: amber-700
tokens.usage: Text on amber-100. A value that differs where it should agree.

tokens.name: amber-500
tokens.usage: LOOKS WRONG. A matched column that does not fit its field, a header row that looks like a title, a source with no program column. Rarely used solid; the tint carries it.

tokens.name: amber-300
tokens.usage: Border of a looks-wrong callout, and the input border of the field it is about.

tokens.name: amber-100
tokens.usage: Fill of a looks-wrong callout and of a row that carries one.

styles.name: h1
styles.sample: Eight stages, all weighted the same
styles.usage: One per artboard at most. Diagnosis and cover pages.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: The stage title under its kicker.

styles.name: count-lg
styles.usage: The two goal numbers on Results. Tabular figures.

styles.name: count
styles.usage: The two counts in the ledger column. Tabular figures.

styles.name: count-row
styles.usage: The row count at the left of a group row. Min width 58px, tabular figures.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Deal with the common causes together first, then anything left over one row at a time.
styles.usage: Stage subtitles, ledger lines, table cells at 12.5.

styles.name: row-title
styles.sample: The ZIP is not five digits
styles.usage: The title of a group row, a callout, a file row.

styles.name: note
styles.sample: 412 of these have a street. The tool can look every one up.
styles.usage: The line under a row title. Color muted.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Notes under controls, ledger sublines. Color muted.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: The ledger footer and field notes. Never smaller.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Uppercase. Above a stage title and above each ledger section. Carries the technical name beside the plain one.

styles.name: strip-kicker
styles.usage: Uppercase. The first line of a stage strip item.

styles.name: stage-name
styles.usage: The second line of a stage strip item. 11.5px under 1360 wide, where the longest names may wrap to two lines.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Every button. 13px for the one primary action in a stage head.

styles.name: column-head
styles.usage: Uppercase. Table column headings on bg-surface.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a label and its input, a title and its note.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between buttons in a group (7px is acceptable), between chips, between rows in a list (5 to 8).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between form fields, inside tight cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on the horizontal, gap between a row count and its text.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Content top and bottom padding at 1280.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Content side padding, top bar side padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Diagnosis page padding, section gaps on the cover.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything. The system is square: cards, buttons, inputs, tags, chips, marks. No exceptions.

layout.note: Fixed dimensions of the cockpit frame.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: The dark top bar.

tokens.name: strip-height
tokens.usage: The stage strip, nine items, three lines each. Grows to fit a wrapped name under 1360.

tokens.name: ledger-width
tokens.usage: The ledger column at 1360 wide and up.

tokens.name: ledger-band-height
tokens.usage: The ledger as a band under the strip, below 1360.

tokens.name: ledger-breakpoint
tokens.usage: Below this the ledger becomes a band and content takes the full width. Nothing scrolls sideways at 1280 or above.

tokens.name: undo-width
tokens.usage: The undo item at the right of the stage strip. 150px under 1360.

tokens.name: row-count-width
tokens.usage: Minimum width of the count column at the left of a group row.

tokens.name: mark-size
tokens.usage: Source letter marks and checkboxes. 14px inside a table cell.

tokens.name: rule-weight
tokens.usage: The underline of a stage strip item and the top rule of a callout. Never on the left.
